title: Loved my first box!
text:
I decided to give this subscription box a try since I never seem to have enough energy for my workday. I'm pleased with the first box I received and enjoyed everything in it. I even found a few items I'd like to purchase personally. I will be continuing with the subscription for now.

Update: I just received my second box and it's the EXACT SAME ITEMS as my previous box (all 5 drinks and even the protein snack and salted caramel spread). I am NOT happy as I wanted to try out DIFFERENT drinks. This will be my last box.
label: neutral
